summary_md:
# AI-aktier på tilbud - eller på vej i gulvet?

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-11-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of the Store Penge podcast. It mainly covers the AI tech sell-off, the US midterm election, the large Binance hack and listener questions. The guest calls the AI sell-off 'outright panic' and irrational, since hyperscaler cloud growth and earnings are still strong. He sees AI as a long-term no-brainer but is waiting before buying the dip, because he expects more short-term pain from rising rates, capex worries and energy and geopolitical risks. He favours ASML and Sandisk, plays down the market impact of the midterm election, and criticises Binance's governance.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ASML — ASML | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest sees ASML as a good long-term opportunity in the AI value chain; it cannot yet raise production fast enough to meet demand.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Mikkel) is very bullish on AI long term and names ASML at the bottom of the value chain as a sure long-term opportunity, because production constraints have held back its growth so far. He is still cautious about buying the AI dip in the short term because of panic and the rate backdrop.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex demand falls
- if production constraints persist without growth materialising
- if rates keep rising and AI panic deepens

> *"Blandt andet helt nede i værdikæden, hvor vi blandt andet har ASML, er jeg ret sikker på, at der er en god langsigtet mulighed"*

---

### 🟢 SNDK — Sandisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest thinks Sandisk will be an extremely good case thanks to large buybacks and an asset-light model, while trading at a low P/E.

#### Reasoning

Answering a listener question, the guest says Sandisk generates high earnings relative to its market value (low P/E), uses an asset-light model that rents capacity, and returns cash through buybacks. He calls it 'vanvittigt godt case', although he generally prefers companies that reinvest in AI.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory pricing or AI demand weakens
- if buybacks are halted

> *"Jeg tror, at Sandisk kommer til at være et vanvittigt godt case, fordi de kommer til at udbetale eller købe aktier tilbage"*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest calls the AI sector a long-term no-brainer but is waiting on the dip; he favours Nvidia's aggressive AI reinvestment.

#### Reasoning

Guest is very bullish on AI long term and likes that Nvidia invests aggressively across the AI ecosystem. He still says this is a dip he does not yet want to buy, expects more panic, and is holding off for now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demand or hyperscaler capex falls
- if rising rates trigger a deeper sell-off

> *"Så det her er et langsigtet no-brainer, men jeg er ikke sikker på, at det er no-brainer på den korte bane."*

---

### 🟠 MU — Micron | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Low P/E; reinvests aggressively in capacity, which the guest prefers long term; the overall AI view is to wait in the short term.

#### Reasoning

Guest prefers AI companies that reinvest in capacity, as Micron does, for long-term upside. He gives no explicit buy call, and his general stance on the AI dip is to wait.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the memory cycle turns down
- if AI capex is cut

> *"hvorimod Micron og Nvidia investerer sig fortsat aggressivt ind i hele AR-accelerationen"*

---
